jobs.title: Senior Back-end Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Back\-end Developer – Electronic Access Control**

  

**Build the backend that connects the future of secure access.**

  

As a **Senior Back\-end Developer**, you will join our skilled, international team of developers based in Stockholm, dedicated to building next\-generation products and access control solutions that enable identity, authentication and access experiences for customers worldwide.


**Why this role matters**

  

At ASSA ABLOY, technology plays a direct role in creating safer, more open environments. Your work will help make sure different product components can communicate and work together reliably — turning individual technologies into complete access solutions.


This is a role for someone who enjoys more than simply implementing requirements. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, solve challenging backend and integration problems, and continuously improve both the software and the way the team works.


**The role**

  

You’ll join a small and strongly connected team working in a highly self\-organised agile environment. The team values close collaboration, open discussion and learning from one another, with approaches such as pair programming and mob programming forming part of how you work together.


You’ll take ownership of backend development and integrations, from designing solutions through to implementation, testing and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute to technical discussions and decisions, while having the independence to explore problems and find solutions before bringing others in.


**What you’ll work on**

  

* **Build and evolve backend services** — develop high\-quality software using Golang and modern software engineering practices, with a focus on distributed systems and product connectivity.
* **Develop APIs and integrations** — create and maintain REST APIs and modern integration patterns that connect different product components.
* **Shape technical solutions** — contribute to software architecture, object\-oriented design and decisions around scalable, maintainable solutions.
* **Strengthen software quality** — work with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and code reviews to help deliver reliable software.
* **Solve complex problems** — troubleshoot and improve existing solutions while looking for practical ways to make the product and development process better.
* **Work closely with the team** — collaborate through pair and mob programming, share knowledge and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

**What will help you succeed**

  

* **5\+ years of backend software development experience**, including designing and delivering production\-grade applications.
* **Hands\-on experience with Golang as a programming language**, together with experience building distributed systems, APIs or backend services.
* **Solid understanding of software architecture and object\-oriented design**, including REST APIs and modern integration patterns.
* **Experience with modern development practices**, particularly CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews.
* **A collaborative and curious mindset** — you enjoy learning from others, sharing knowledge and remaining open to new ideas, technologies and perspectives. You see change as an opportunity to improve products, processes and team effectiveness.

  

**Nice to have:** Some experience with the .NET ecosystem.


**Why ASSA ABLOY**

  

You’ll join a global organisation where you can work on technology with a real\-world purpose, while having the trust and freedom to shape how you contribute. You’ll be part of a small team where collaboration is close, ideas are welcome and continuous improvement is part of everyday work.

  

* **Meaningful mission** — Build software that helps connect secure access solutions used in real\-world environments around the world.
* **Innovation \& scale** — Develop your expertise across distributed systems, backend services, integrations and modern software engineering within a global technology organisation.
* **Autonomy \& trust** — Work in a self\-organised team where you’re encouraged to take ownership, explore solutions and influence technical decisions.
* **Growth \& development** — Learn from experienced colleagues, contribute across the technology stack and continuously develop your technical and problem\-solving skills.
* **Work–life balance** — Work from Stockholm in a hybrid setup, within a Scandinavian culture built around collaboration, trust and sustainable ways of working.

**Ready to build the connections behind secure access?**

  

Apply today and join the team in shaping the backend and integrations behind the next generation of Electronic Access Control.


We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner.


Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.

  



**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

jobs.description:
### **Associate Technical Services Engineer II (Cloud)**



MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem \- database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.



Due to the 24/7 nature of our support organization, certain events throughout the year will require volunteering for coverage outside one's normal work days or work hours (i.e. regional offsites, regional holidays, etc). These are typically announced weeks in advance with a sign\-up system that considers equitability.


### **Cool things you'll do**



You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges \- resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs \- interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.


### **What you need**



We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self\-taught, insatiably curious, and multi\-faceted.



The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in one (or more) of the following areas


* Systems administration
* Distributed systems
* Network Administration
* Database architecture and administration
* Application Architecture
* Data architecture and design
* Performance tuning and benchmarking
* Extra bonus points if you have experience in one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C\+\+, C\#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl


If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large\-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud\-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).



It's crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes


* 2\- 3 years of specific engineering experience in technical engineering
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Genuine desire to help people
* Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real\-time
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
* Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help

### **About MongoDB**



MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.



With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Company**


The Irish Times Group is Ireland's leading independent quality news publishing organisation, owned by The Irish Times Trust and managed by The Irish Times DAC, evolving from a six\-day print publisher into a seven\-day, multi\-platform media group encompassing titles such as The Irish Times, Irish Examiner, The Echo, regional newspapers, The GLOSS Magazine, and digital platforms including MyHome.ie and RIP.ie, reaching millions of readers across Ireland and internationally.

 **The Role**


We are seeking mid\-level Test Automation Engineers to build and scale our test automation capability as part of our strategic development capacity expansion. These roles are critical to enabling our growing development teams to deliver features faster whilst maintaining the quality standards our readers expect.

  

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for our web applications and mobile apps. You'll work collaboratively with developers, QA, and product teams to establish automation frameworks and practices that scale with our growing engineering organisation.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Test Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web applications and mobile apps (iOS/Android)
* Write clear, maintainable, and efficient test code following software engineering best practices
* Implement end\-to\-end, integration, and regression tests across our publishing platform
* Build reusable test components and frameworks to accelerate automation coverage
* Debug and troubleshoot test failures, distinguishing product issues from test infrastructure problems

 **CI/CD Integration**

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous feedback
* Configure test execution environments and manage test data
* Monitor test execution and maintain test suite health
* Optimise test execution time and reliability
* Integrate Reporting and Monitoring tools.

 **Collaboration \& Quality**

* Work closely with developers to understand features and identify automation opportunities
* Collaborate with QA team to prioritise automation backlog based on business impact
* Participate in code reviews for both production and test code
* Contribute to defining and improving testing standards and practices
* Document automation frameworks, patterns, and processes

 **Continuous Improvement**

* Identify areas where automation can improve velocity and quality
* Evaluate and recommend testing tools and technologies
* Refactor and maintain existing test suites to prevent technical debt
* Share knowledge and mentor team members on automation practices

 **Requirements \& Experience**

**Core Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript required, with demonstrable experience in modern frameworks and tools.
* Experience with additional languages (Python, Java, C\#).
* 2\-4 years experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress (web), Appium, Detox, XCUITest, BrowserStack, or REST Assured, Postman (API)
* Experience working with Test Management and Agile Methodologies.
* Solid experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
* Hands\-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipeline, or similar)
* Strong understanding of testing principles, test design patterns, and best practices

 **Professional Experience**

* 2\-4 years in software testing with focus on test automation
* Proven track record of building and maintaining automated test suites in production environments
* Experience working in agile development teams
* Demonstrable ability to write clean, maintainable code

 **Personal Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Good communication skills for technical and non\-technical audiences
* Collaborative mindset \- comfortable working across development, QA, and product teams
* Self\-motivated with ability to work independently and prioritise effectively
* Attention to detail whilst maintaining focus on business impact

 **Desirable Requirements**

* Experience with multiple testing frameworks and ability to evaluate trade\-offs
* Knowledge of performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6\)
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Knowledge of database testing and SQL
* Experience in digital media, publishing, or content management systems is nice to have
* Understanding of web performance optimisation and SEO considerations
* Mobile app testing experience across iOS and Android platforms

 **Application Process**


Please apply with your CV through the Apply button below.

  

The Irish Times Group operates a Hybrid working policy and is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

  

Our benefits include Health Insurance contribution, Pension Contribution, Sick Leave Cover, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Irish Times Premium Digital Subscription, Income Protection Policy, Corporate Gym Membership discounts, Free Digital GP and Life Assurance Policy.

* Faster delivery of strategic AI initiatives and productivity gains
* Reduced time and cost to develop future AI solutions through reusable capabilities
* Scalable and secure deployment of AI across the enterprise
* Improved decision\-making through trusted access to data and knowledge
* Greater business value realisation through governance, AgentOps, telemetry, and FinOps practices
* Competitive advantage through accelerated AI innovation and automation

  

Key Candidate Selling Points

Help shape how AI is implemented across a Fortune 500 consumer goods company, creating capabilities that thousands of employees could eventually leverage.

* **Cross\-Functional Influence**


Partner with senior leaders, architects, security teams, product owners, data engineers, and business stakeholders to solve high\-value business challenges.

* **Solve Real Business Problems**


Build AI capabilities that improve decision\-making, automate complex workflows, increase productivity, and create measurable business value.

**What we look for:**

**Experience**

* 7\-10 years software engineering, platform engineering, data/AI engineering, automation, or cloud application development; 5\-7 years with MS/PhD acceptable.

* Experience implementing reusable agent skills, action connectors, approval flows, eval tests, troubleshooting runtime and tool\-call failures.
* Product mindset, ownership, documentation, agile delivery and ability to translate business needs into working agent capabilities.

 **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data/AI, Cybersecurity, Finance, Business Analytics or relevant stream. Equivalent experience acceptable depending on role and grade evaluation.

**Workplace type:**


\#LI\-Hybrid**Our values\-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive.** **Learn more****.**

**Benefits we offer to help you be well and thrive:**

* Flexible work environment, depending on your role

jobs.title: Project Engineer – Process Water Treatment (Data Centre Sector)
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

  

Due to continued growth and the award of multiple data centre utilitywater and processwater treatment projects, EPS Group is expanding its MEICA engineering team. We are seeking a Project Engineer with strong technical expertise in water treatment processes to support the delivery of critical process\-water systems in hyperscale and enterprise data centres across Ireland and Europe.


In this role, you will support the design, installation, integration and commissioning of advanced water treatment systems used in mission\-critical cooling, humidification, and process applications. You will work closely with multidisciplinary EPS teams, supply\-chain partners and major data centre operators to ensure the safe, timely and efficient delivery of highreliability process\-water infrastructure.


This is a varied role combining design coordination, project delivery, site engineering and commissioning support. Depending on project phase, it may be officebased, sitebased or hybrid.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

 **Project Engineering \& Delivery**

* Manage and support all mechanical, electrical and ICA aspects of process\-water treatment installations within data centres.
* Interpret and work from P\&IDs, technical drawings, design specifications and functional control narratives.
* Support the design team in developing innovative solutions using modern water\-treatment technologies (RO, UF, ion exchange, dosing, filtration).
* Coordinate procurement activities, including selection and ordering of pumps, skids, valves, instruments and control systems.
* Develop project schedules and ensure all interfaces\-from design through installation to commissioning\-are fully accounted for and delivered.

**Process Water Treatment Systems**

* Oversee installation, integration and performance validation of systems such as:
* Reverse Osmosis (RO)
* Ultrafiltration (UF)
* Softening and demineralisation
* Chemical dosing and disinfection
* Polishing and high\-purity systems
* Monitor process stability and water quality parameters to ensure system compliance with data centre operational requirements.

**Data Centre Integration \& Coordination**

* Work alongside M\&E contractors, BMS/SCADA teams and client representatives within live or construction\-stage data centre environments.
* Ensure water treatment systems integrate seamlessly with cooling towers, adiabatic coolers, chilled\-water loops and makeup water systems.
* Support commissioning teams in FAT/SAT, functional testing, start\-up, optimisation and handover.

**Safety, Documentation \& Reporting**

* Coordinate project safety requirements and liaise with the EPS HSQE team to ensure best\-in\-class safety practices.
* Prepare engineering documentation including method statements, risk assessments, O\&M manuals, commissioning schedules and progress reports.
* Manage site labour, subcontractors and daily installation activities while ensuring all work adheres to EPS and client safety standards.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Liaise and coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors and internal project teams to ensure smooth project delivery.
* Attend progress meetings, technical reviews and commissioning walkdowns.
* Support training and handover processes for client operations teams.

 **Key Competencies and Skills:**

* Proven experience in a Mechanical/Electrical/Process Engineering environment.
* Strong knowledge of water treatment technologies and associated mechanical/ICA equipment.
* Experience with PLC, SCADA or BMS\-controlled systems in industrial environments.
* Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks within time\-sensitive project schedules.
* Willingness to learn, innovate and deliver within the fast\-paced data centre sector.

 **Qualifications:**

* Third\-level qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Environmental or Automation Engineering.
* Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Full EU/Irish driving licence.
* Additional industry certifications (IOSH/NEBOSH, water treatment, commissioning) are beneficial.

 **Compensation Package:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* CPD accredited employer
* A collaborative and supportive work environment
* Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided
* Flexible working options, dependent on location and role requirements
* See company website for more information on the benefits of working in EPS Group

  

We welcome speculative applications from individuals of all levels.


If you are interested in working with us but are not sure if the role above is for you, please feel free to get in touch for an informal discussion about what we do and what you could bring to the team. If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request during your recruitment journey, please let our recruiting team know.


Speak to our recruiting team on 022\-31200 or email jobs@epswater.com.

 **Equal Opportunity Statement** \- EPS Group is an equal opportunities employer.

 **Company Profile**

*Since 1968, we have grown from a modest electrical and pumping services business and developed into an innovative, internationally exporting product and service provider, now focused upon the water, wastewater and clean technology sectors, operating across the Republic of Ireland, the UK and Europe.*

*We are an international water infrastructure specialist, one of the few genuine end\-to\-end service providers in the global water sector, providing large scale employment, bringing market leading and ground breaking technologies to Ireland and working to improve the country's water infrastructure.*

*Our vision is to be the best and most rewarding place to work for our teams, to be our customer's outstanding partner of choice and we are committed to being a Net Zero, sustainable business.*

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack App Developer
jobs.description:
**Joining Team Norse is more than getting a job. It is all about belonging.**


Always dreamt of doing things differently? Join us in Comtech at Norse Atlantic Airways, where we build the digital products behind a challenger airline.


We think differently and we act differently. We are not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and test new ideas. We are a data\-driven, product\-first organization powered by a small, tight\-knit team of developers, product managers and data scientists — plus a few potatoes.


If these prospects inspire you, then we want to talk to you!


Potatoes: a Norwegian term for people who can do a little bit of everything.

 **Why This Role is Exciting**


Our Flutter app is at the heart of Norse's digital experience, and we're looking for someone to take real ownership of it. You'll be the driving force behind the mobile app while working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with a small engineering team — which means your day won't stop at the app. In a lean team, the best people wear more than one hat, so you'll also jump in to support the wider stack: our GraphQL layer, our .NET / C\# backend services, and the integrations that hold it all together. Your heart is in app development, but your reach goes across the whole product.


This role sits within Comtech and reports to the Head of Ecom and Product.  

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**

  

Flutter App Development (your main focus)

* Own the design, development and maintenance of our cross\-platform mobile app in Flutter and Dart, delivering a high\-performing, scalable and user\-friendly experience on both iOS and Android.
* Drive the app's architecture and set best practices for state management, testing and release, keeping the codebase clean and maintainable.
* Partner with UX/UI designers to build intuitive, engaging interfaces, and iterate based on user testing and experimentation.
* Optimize app performance — load times, responsiveness and stability — across a wide range of devices.


Backend \& Fullstack Support

* Roll up your sleeves alongside the rest of the team to support our general stack, contributing to backend services built with .NET Core and C\#.
* Design, consume and extend GraphQL APIs that connect the app and web front\-ends to our backend systems.
* Help design robust, secure and reliable integrations, ensuring smooth communication between the app, the backend and third\-party services.
* Support and unblock fellow engineers across the stack — reviewing code, pairing and stepping in wherever the team needs an extra pair of hands.


Architecture \& Collaboration

* Take ownership of end\-to\-end delivery, from architecture through to deployment, following clean architecture principles.
* Work within Agile Scrum, participating in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives with product managers, designers and fellow engineers.
* Collaborate closely with a cross\-functional team to ship a best\-in\-class product, fast.


Code Review, Mentorship \& Innovation

* Conduct thorough code reviews and champion high coding standards across the app and the wider stack.
* Mentor and support other developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
* Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends, proposing and implementing ideas that push our products forward.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 5\+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on mobile development in Flutter and Dart.
* Proven experience shipping and maintaining production mobile apps on iOS and Android.
* Solid backend experience with .NET Core and C\#, and comfort working across a fullstack codebase.
* Hands\-on experience with GraphQL (designing, consuming or extending APIs).
* Experience with RESTful APIs and integrating third\-party services.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* A passion for clean, maintainable and scalable code, and strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile teams, and a startup mindset that thrives in a small, high\-ownership team.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (desired but not required).

**AI\-Assisted Development**

* Proficient with AI\-assisted and agentic software development tools such as Claude Code — or able to become proficient very quickly — using them effectively for coding, codebase exploration, refactoring, debugging, testing, code review and engineering automation.
* Comfortable designing workflows where AI agents can safely perform or accelerate repetitive engineering tasks, while applying appropriate review and engineering judgment.
* Actively explores new AI\-assisted development practices and helps establish effective patterns for using them across the team.

**Why Join Comtech?**

**Take real ownership of a product used by travelers around the world.**

* Work in an innovative, fast\-paced environment where your work truly matters.
* Get access to leading AI development tools, with their use encouraged as part of the normal development workflow — we're building a modern, highly productive small engineering team.
* Flexible work arrangements at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.
* Enjoy the same great staff travel benefits as employees across Norse Atlantic Airways.
* Join a dynamic and international team building the future of airline travel.

**This position is located at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.**

**Here's a taste of what life in Arendal and Southern Norway has to offer:**

**www.visitsorlandet.com**

**www.gotoarendal.com**

**www.welcomehub.no**

**www.businessregionkristiansand.no**

**If you're ready to take ownership of our app and help build something that matters in the airline industry, we'd love to hear from you!**  



**We believe that culture will be our competitive advantage.**


Team Norse has identified three core values that we all should live and breathe.  

They are:


* Be inclusive
* Take ownership
* Show kindness.

**Deadline to apply : 15 October.**

  

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to send an email to: careers@flynorse.com


Please note: you have 2 days from submission to edit your cover letter before it can no longer be changed.

Iterate AS


Schweigaards gate 34E, 0191 Oslo

-------------


Lagre favoritt

Full\-Stack Utvikler

**Norges skarpeste fagmiljø innen digital produktutvikling søker fullstack\-utviklere som vil bygge fremtidens AI\-systemer \- i produksjon, ikke i sandkassen.** **Om Iterate**


Iterate er et Oslo\-basert produktutviklingsmiljø kjent for å skape løsninger som faktisk tas i bruk og gjør en forskjell. Vi bygger tjenester og selskaper sammen med kundene våre \- noen ganger fra en idé, noen ganger tar vi over og videreutvikler et produkt som allerede finnes. Fellesnevneren er at vi jobber tett med kundene, tester i virkelige situasjoner og lærer raskt.


Vi har et økende antall prosjekter som inkluderer bruk av AI i praktiske produkt\- og tjenesteløsninger. Derfor ser vi etter utviklere som ikke bare kan kode, men som forstår hvordan maskinlæring, store språkmodeller og datadrevne verktøy kan omsettes til produkter som oppleves som nyttige og intuitive.


**Rollen**
Vi ser etter deg som ikke bare bygger det som er spesifisert, men som har vært med på å forme et produkt fra første idé til markedet og videre inn i skalering. Du kjenner igjen fasene: det kaotiske nullpunktet, pivotene på vei mot product\-market fit, produksjonssettingen med ekte brukere og kravene som følger med vekst. Denne erfaringen er like viktig for oss som det tekniske.


Du vil jobbe i tverrfaglige team tett med designere, fagpersoner og domeneeksperter \- og du forventes å bidra aktivt til kunnskapsoverføring og faglig utvikling, ikke bare levere kode.


#### **Hva du vil jobbe med**


* Bygge brukerflater der brukerne samhandler med og har oversikt over AI\-agenter som utfører oppgaver på vegne av dem
* Integrere AI\-agenter med eksisterende systemer, API\-er og databaser
* Bygge backend\-løsninger og arbeidsflyter ved hjelp av MCP\-arkitektur og andre integrasjonsmodeller
* Løse tekniske utfordringer spesifikke for AI\-grensesnitt: streaming, agent\-tilstander, sanntidsoppdateringer og mekanismer for menneskelig inngripen
* Bidra til arkitektur og tekniske valg i et felt der ikke alle svar er gitt på forhånd
* Bidra aktivt i produktdiskusjoner og forme hva som bygges, ikke bare hvordan
* Bidra til CI/CD\-pipelines og god ingeniørpraksis i et distribuert team

#### **Teknisk profil**


Vi ser etter deg med solid erfaring fra minst noen av følgende teknologier:


**Frontend**
* TypeScript og moderne React
* State management og arkitektur for komplekse brukerflater
* Integrasjon mot AI\-tjenester og LLM\-baserte backends
* JavaScript, React Native og Node.js

**Backend**
* .NET og C\#, gjerne med moderne .NET 6/7/8
* Java, Kotlin eller Go
* Integrasjon av LLM\-er og AI\-agenter i produksjonssystemer
* Agentic AI\-rammeverk, f.eks. Semantic Kernel eller tilsvarende
* API\-design, systemintegrasjon og mikrotjenestearkitektur
* Kubernetes, containerbasert drift og CI/CD\-verktøy
* Sky\-plattformer: Azure, AWS eller GCP

Kjennskap til MCP (Model Context Protocol), Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search eller vektordatabaser er et klart ønske. **Hvem vi ser etter**


Du kombinerer teknisk tyngde med produktinstinkt og evnen til å stille spørsmål ved kravene, ikke bare oppfylle dem. Du liker å jobbe i tverrfaglige team, er komfortabel i konsulentrollen, er aktiv i dialogen med kunder og lærer gjerne bort det du kan.


Du er komfortabel med uferdig informasjon i miljøer der retningen justeres underveis \- og du vet når det er tid for å levere fremfor å utforske videre. Vi ser etter folk med et entreprenørmindset som kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk, og som ønsker å bidra til Norges beste fagmiljø innen digital produktutvikling.


**Hvordan vi jobber**
* Små, autonome team med kort vei fra idé til prototyp og fra prototyp til brukertesting
* Tett samarbeid mellom design, utvikling og produkt
* Åpen kultur der det er naturlig å diskutere valg, utfordringer og løsninger
* Fokus på å bygge produkter som fungerer i virkeligheten, ikke bare på skjerm

**Dette tilbyr vi**
* Et av Norges mest engasjerte fagmiljøer innen produktutvikling
* Muligheter til å jobbe med alt fra startups til store etablerte virksomheter
* Mulighet til å være med og starte nye ventures sammen med oss
* Konkurransedyktig lønn, pensjons\- og forsikringsordninger
* Mulighet til medeierskap i Iterate og i nye selskaper vi bygger
* Et miljø der ideer ikke bare blir diskutert, men realisert

jobs.title: Design Engineer, Nuclear Safety
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team dedicated to ensuring the safe and efficient operation of nuclear power plants?

  

As a Design Engineer in our Nuclear Safety team at Fortum, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of nuclear energy. In this role you will collaborate with a diverse group of experts to support Fortum’s internal preparatory work for possible nuclear newbuild, external nuclear customers, and co\-owned units. If you're passionate about nuclear safety and ready to take on new challenges, we want to hear from you!

  

**About the role**
  

We are looking for a Design Engineer. Your position in the organization is in the Nuclear Safety team of Engineering \& Projects (E\&P) business area, located in Espoo, Finland. The Nuclear Safety team has a wide range of different competencies which are utilized in supporting safe and efficient operations of our nuclear units, external nuclear customers, and the development of new nuclear and nuclear R\&D activities in Fortum.

  

As Design Engineer, you will work closely with our other nuclear experts and external partners to create solutions for our customers in Finland and internationally.

  

The core focus of this role is severe accident analysis and model development. Your primary responsibilities will be:


* Perform, report, and deliver severe accident analyses using MELCOR.
* Maintain and develop the severe accident analysis model of Loviisa NPP.
* Evaluate and develop severe accident management concepts for new nuclear projects.

  

Depending on your background, strengths, and interests, you may also:


* Perform assessments related to nuclear safety and safety design.
* Support compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, safeguards obligations, and export control requirements.

  

**About you**
  

We expect you to have a master’s degree or other relevant degree e.g. in nuclear engineering, energy technology, power plant engineering or physics. To succeed and thrive in this role:


* You have experience with MELCOR, MAAP, CONTAIN, or other lumped\-parameter codes.
* You are proficient in using Python for post\-processing, data analysis, and automation of engineering tasks.
* You have a solid understanding of nuclear power plant technologies, severe accident phenomena, including in\-vessel retention (IVR), and nuclear safety principles. Familiarity with SMRs and advanced reactor concepts is considered an advantage.
* You are familiar with Finnish and international nuclear licensing and regulatory requirements.
* You have fluent oral and written communication skills in English, and the ability to read and understand Finnish is essential, as some documentation and background materials are available only in Finnish. Swedish is considered an advantage.

  

**We offer you**
  

At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.

  

More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.

  

Espoo office is a smoke\-free workplace.

  

**Interested?**
  

Submit your application by **15\.10\.2026** at the latest. If you would like to hear more about the position, please contact Kaisu Leino through e\-mail kaisu.leino@fortum.com

  

As part of our recruitment process, we use assessment tests, digital reference checks and Microsoft Copilot to transcribe interviews. This helps us ensure a structured, fair and high\-quality process for all candidates. To be selected for the position, the applicant must go through background clearance and a health examination including drug testing.

  

**We are Fortum**
  

Fortum is a Nordic energy company. jobs.title: Kokenut full-stack -ohjelmistokehittäjä Defence & Security –toimialan projekteihin
jobs.description:
Haluatko kehittää teknologiaa, jolla on aitoa merkitystä? Solitalla pääset rakentamaan Defence and Security (DefSec) \-toimialalle digitaalisia ratkaisuja, joissa korostuvat turvallisuus, toimintavarmuus ja vaikuttavuus. Etsimme nyt tiimiimme kokenutta full\-stack \-kehittäjää, joka haluaa soveltaa osaamistaan vaativissa, korkean turvallisuustason ympäristöissä.



Etsimme Solitalle kokeneita full\-stack\-ohjelmistokehittäjiä erityisesti Helsingin ja Tampereen seuduille DefSec –alueen asiakasprojekteihin. Tapauskohtaisesti sijaintisi voi olla myös muilla toimistopaikkakunnillamme (Turku, Oulu, Jyväskylä, Lahti, Pori, Kuopio, Joensuu ja Vaasa), mikäli Helsinkiin matkustaminen onnistuu tarvittaessa säännöllisesti.


Pääset työskentelemään ohjelmistokehitysprojekteissa, joissa rakennetaan turvallisia, toimintavarmoja ja pitkäikäisiä digitaalisia ratkaisuja DefSec\-toimialalle. Näissä hankkeissa teknologialla on suora yhteys esimerkiksi yhteiskunnan turvallisuuteen, tilannekuvan muodostamiseen, viranomaisten yhteistyöhön ja kriittisten operaatioiden sujuvuuteen. Solitalla DefSec \-toimialan tekeminen kattaa esimerkiksi turvalliset digitaaliset alustat, korkean turvallisuustason operatiiviset järjestelmät, AI\-pohjaisen analytiikan ja erilaiset tilannekuvaratkaisut.


Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa esimerkiksi operatiivisten turvallisuus\- ja tilannekuvajärjestelmien kehittämistä, viranomaisyhteistyötä tukevien alustojen modernisointia, navigointiin ja autonomisiin järjestelmiin liittyviä ratkaisuja sekä tekoälyn hyödyntämisen edellytysten rakentamista korkean turvallisuustason ympäristöihin. Etsimme yhdessä projektivalikoimastamme sinulle kiinnostavan kokonaisuuden, jossa pääset yhdistämään modernin full\-stack\-kehityksen, konsultatiivisen työotteen ja korkean turvallisuustason vaatimukset.


### **Millaisessa roolissa työskentelet?**


Ohjelmistokehittäjänä olet mukana koko kehityskaarella ideasta toteutukseen, jatkokehitykseen ja ylläpitoon asti. Suunnittelet, rakennat ja kehität turvallisia, skaalautuvia ja helposti ylläpidettäviä ohjelmistoratkaisuja asiakkaidemme tarpeisiin. DefSec\-projekteissa tämä tarkoittaa usein järjestelmiä, joiden tulee toimia luotettavasti vaativissa ympäristöissä, integroitua osaksi laajempia kokonaisuuksia ja täyttää korkeat tietoturvan, toimintavarmuuden ja ylläpidettävyyden vaatimukset.


Roolisi ytimessä on työskennellä teknisessä roolissa konsultatiivisella otteella: ymmärrät asiakkaan toiminnallisia ja liiketoiminnallisia tarpeita ja käännät ne fiksuiksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Arjessa työskentelet sujuvasti niin backendin kuin frontendinkin parissa. Automaatio, testaus, DevOps\-ajattelu ja jatkuva toimitus ovat meillä luonnollinen osa tekemistä.


Tehtävän painotukset voivat vaihdella kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan, ja rooli tarjoaa myös hyviä mahdollisuuksia kasvattaa omaa osaamista. Arjessa osallistut ominaisuuksien kehittämiseen ja suunnitteluun sekä ratkot teknisiä haasteita yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Kokeneempana kehittäjänä otat enemmän vastuuta laajemmista kokonaisuuksista, teknisestä suunnasta ja ratkaisujen laadusta, samalla tukien sekä tiimiä että asiakasta käytännön tekemisessä.


Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmista painotuksista ja vastuun laajuudesta kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen roolin kokonaisuudesta, kuukausipalkkasi sijoittuu tyypillisesti 4700–5600 euron välille. Palkka on kiinteä kuukausipalkka, ja lisäksi käytössäsi ovat Solitan kattavat luontoisedut.


### **Millaista osaamista toivomme sinulta?**


* Vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta fullstack\-ohjelmistokehityksestä ja vahvaa backend\-osaamista joidenkin seuraavien teknologioiden osalta: Typescript/Node.js, C\#, Java. Frontend\-kehityksen puolella sinulla on kokemusta moderneista frontend\-teknologioista, kuten React.js tai Vue.js.
* Kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä on\-prem ja hybridiympäristöissä.
* Katsomme eduksi, jos sinulla on ymmärrystä C4ISR\-järjestelmistä sekä miehittämättömien järjestelmien autonomiseen ja parviohjaukseen liittyvistä ratkaisuista.
* Kokemusta tekoälyavusteisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä työkontekstissa, ja kiinnostusta tekoälyn tuomiin mahdollisuuksiin.
* Kokemusta asiakasyhteistyöstä ja kykyä ymmärtää liiketoimintatarpeita teknisten ratkaisujen taustalla.
* Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.
* Kokeneemman kehittäjän roolissa odotamme myös aikaisempaa kokemusta teknisestä suunnittelusta ja kykyä ratkaista monimutkaisia teknisiä ongelmia, valmiuksia ottaa vastuuta kehityksen ohjaamisesta, arkkitehtuuriratkaisuista ja teknisestä suunnasta.
* Aikaisempi työkokemus turvallisuuskriittisisten järjestelmien ja korkean tietoturvan toimintaympäristöiden projekteista nähdään etuna.

### **Solita työpaikkana**


Solitalla pääset työskentelemään muiden huippuasiantuntijoiden kanssa, ja vaikuttamaan työlläsi merkityksellisten DefSec –ratkaisujen kehittämiseen. Meillä työskentelet osana tiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät moderni ohjelmistokehitys, korkeat laatu\- ja tietoturvavaatimukset sekä vahva yhteistyökulttuuri. Saat ympärillesi osaavia ja helposti lähestyttäviä kollegoita, ja tuemme osaamisesi kehittämistä koulutusten, sisäisten yhteisöjen ja aktiivisen tiedonjaon kautta.


Kulttuurimme perustuu luottamukseen, vapauteen ja vastuullisuuteen. Kiinteä palkkamallimme tukee hyvää yhteistyötä sekä työntekijöidemme arjen tasapainoa, ja tarjoamme kattavat edut, mukaan lukien laadukkaat työvälineet, kattavan työterveyden, hyvinvointietuja, harrastekerhoja ja yhteisiä tapahtumia.


### **Kiinnostuitko?**


Katsotaan yhdessä, voisiko seuraava askel urallasi olla Solitalla. Lähetä meille CV:si tai linkki LinkedIn\-profiiliisi, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä pian.


Rekrytointiprosessimme koostuu kahdesta haastattelukierroksesta, joiden aikana pääset tapaamaan tiimiämme ja kuulemaan lisää työskentelystä Solitalla. Saat mahdollisuuden näyttää osaamistasi sekä esittää meille kysymyksiä. Haastatteluiden tarkoituksena on tutustua toisiimme paremmin.


Jos sinulle heräsi kysyttävää, voit olla yhteydessä rekrytoijaamme Julia Oksaan (etunimi.sukunimi@solita.fi).


Keskeisenä teknologia\-, data\- ja designkumppanina Solitan liiketoiminta perustuu luottamukseen ja vastuullisuuteen. Tästä syystä valitun hakijan henkilöllisyys ja työhistoria tarkistetaan. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa.


Tässä tehtävässä työskentely voi edellyttää asiakkaamme pyynnöstä tehtävää turvallisuusselvitystä. Turvallisuusselvitys toteutetaan turvallisuusselvityslain mukaisesti, ja sen hyväksytty läpäiseminen on tehtävässä työskentelyn edellytys.

Indicative daily rate


€672 – 840/day

09 Oct 2026  

Skills


Project ManagementProject Management
**Objectif :**


Améliorer et étendre les fonctionnalités d'une plateforme existante de gestion des cours développée en C\# avec une base de données PostgreSQL, afin d'optimiser l'expérience des enseignants et des étudiants.


**Contexte :**


La plateforme existante est un système de gestion des cours développé en C\# avec PostgreSQL comme système de gestion de base de données. L'objectif est d'ajouter de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour améliorer la gestion des cours, l'engagement des étudiants et les outils à disposition des enseignants.


Dans le cadre de cette mission, nous sommes à la recherche de 3 profils qui devront provenir de la meme société afin de faciliter la collaboration et l'exécution de la mission.


**Profils recherchés :**


* Chef de projet


* Analyste


* Développeur


**Nouvelles fonctionnalités à implémenter :**


* Système de suivi des progrès des étudiants avec tableaux de bord personnalisés


* Fonctionnalité de planification avancée des cours et des sessions


* Système de communication intégré (messagerie, forum de discussion)


* API RESTful pour l'intégration avec d'autres outils éducatifs


* Rôles et responsabilités


**Chef de projet Medior :**


* Coordination avec l'équipe de maintenance existante et les parties prenantes éducatives


* Planification de l'intégration des nouvelles fonctionnalités


* Gestion des risques liés à la modification d'une plateforme éducative en production


* Suivi de l'avancement et reporting aux administrateurs de l'établissement


**Étapes clés :**


* Analyse de l'existant et recueil des besoins éducatifs


* Conception des nouvelles fonctionnalités


* Développement des extensions


* Tests, optimisation et intégration


Langage principal : C\#


Framework : .NET (version à spécifier selon l'existant)


Base de données : PostgreSQL


ORM : Entity Framework Core


Frontend : ASP.NET Core MVC ou Blazor (selon l'architecture existante)


API : ASP.NET Core Web API


Tests : NUnit ou xUnit


Gestion de projet : Azure DevOps ou Jira


**Contraintes techniques :**


* Assurer la compatibilité avec la version existante de C\# et .NET


* Optimiser les requêtes PostgreSQL pour gérer un grand nombre d'utilisateurs et de cours


* Respecter les normes de sécurité et de confidentialité des données éducatives


* Garantir l'accessibilité des nouvelles fonctionnalités pour tous les utilisateurs


* Concevoir une interface utilisateur intuitive et responsive


**La société qui sera en charge de l'exécution de la mission devra pouvoir nous fournir les 3 profils demandés afin de faciliter la collaboration et la réalisation de la mission. Dans le cas contraire, les candidatures proposées seront automatiquement écartées.**


**Requirements**
----------------


### **Skills**


* Project Management — Confirmed
### **Languages**


* French — Active knowledge

**Go for IT!**

Userfull Powered by ConXioN is op zoek naar Software Developer voor de uitwerking van back\-end en front\-end projecten. Userfull maakt deel uit van de ConXion\-Groep en opereert autonoom vanuit Boom.


Je werkt binnen een team van ervaren ontwikkelaars aan nieuwe en bestaande projecten voor onze klanten, met een duidelijke focus op de Microsoft\-stack. Je bouwt en onderhoudt **stabiele, moderne cloud\-first applicaties** en integraties, voornamelijk op basis van **C\# .NET, Azure en DevOps**.


De kern van de rol ligt bij **back\-end development**: het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van robuuste services, API’s en synchronisatielagen tussen bestaande systemen. Je analyseert samen met collega’s en klanten de functionele en technische noden en vertaalt deze naar duurzame oplossingen. Je bent betrokken bij implementatie, integratie en verdere optimalisatie in productieomgevingen.

* Je komt terecht in een teamgerichte en jonge werkomgeving waar **inhoud, verantwoordelijkheid en autonomie** centraal staan. Ook snel schakelen en snelle beslissingen behoren tot ons DNA.
* Je krijgt ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen uiteenlopende projecten, met begeleiding waar nodig en voldoende technische uitdaging.
* Marktconforme verloning en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, verzekeringen, thuiswerkvergoeding, 12 ADV\-dagen en een wagen of mobiliteitsbudget.

jobs.title: Project engineer
jobs.description:
*Ben jij een technisch sterke en zelfstandige Project Engineer met een passie voor techniek, engineering en het realiseren van industriële projecten? Vind je het interessant om technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en ben je graag betrokken van engineering tot en met de uitvoering? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.*


**Wat bieden wij?**


* Een salaris van minimaal €3\.500 en maximaal €5\.000 afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring;
* Bedrijfswagen met tank/ laadkaart is bespreekbaar
* Eindejaarspremie van 1/12 per gepresteerde maand, vanaf 6 maanden tewerkstelling;
* Jaarlijkse premie naar rato van gepresteerde maanden;
* Jaarlijkse ecocheques van maximaal €250, bij onvolledige prestatie heb je recht op een deel van de premie;
* Maaltijdcheques van €8,\- per dag;
* Bij een arbeidsduur van 40 uur per week, heb je recht op 20 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV dagen;
* Het vakantiegeld bedraagt 92% van het maandsalaris naar rato dat je in dienst bent geweest en wordt het volgende jaar uitbetaald;
* Verlof wettelijke feestdagen (10 dagen);
* Hospitalisatieverzekering;
* Groepsverzekering;
* Mogelijkheid tot studie via Vecon Engineers.


**Wat ga je doen?**



Een consultant is iemand die ondersteuning of advies biedt aan bedrijven. Meestal doe je dit op locatie bij een klant. Met jouw kennis en ervaring zorg je voor praktische en op maat gemaakte oplossingen die aansluiten bij de specifieke behoeften van de klant.



Werkzaamheden:


* Verantwoordelijk voor de technische realisatie van kleinere multidisciplinaire CAPEX\-projecten binnen de zware industrie, met een gemiddelde projectwaarde van circa €150\.000\.
* Vertalen van een projectvraag naar een technisch ontwerp en uitvoerbare scope, waarbij je zelf inhoudelijk betrokken bent bij de engineering.
* Coördineren en afstemmen van mechanische, E\&I\-en proces\-engineering, inclusief het beoordelen van technische ontwerpen, berekeningen en documentatie.
* Begeleiden van de technische uitvoering en commissioning van projecten, zoals de vervanging van warmtewisselaars, revisie van koeltorens en vernieuwing van opslagtanks.
* Bewaken van technische kwaliteit, planning en budget en optreden als technisch aanspreekpunt voor productie, maintenance, leveranciers en contractors.


**Wie ben je?**



De volgende persoonlijke eigenschappen passen goed bij deze functie:


* Praktisch en oplossingsgericht: je weet technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete en haalbare oplossingen en houdt daarbij oog voor de praktijk.
* Communicatief en verbindend: je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende disciplines, interne stakeholders, leveranciers en contractors.
* Zelfstandig en verantwoordelijk: je neemt eigenaarschap over je projecten, houdt overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken en deadlines worden opgevolgd.


Technische kennis:


* Bachelor of master in een technische richting, bijvoorbeeld Industrieel Ingenieur Elektromechanica, Werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding.
* Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen engineering, projectengineering of een industriële productieomgeving.
* Goede technische basiskennis van mechanische installaties, procesinstallaties en industriële equipment.
* Ervaring met het uitwerken, beoordelen en coördineren van technische ontwerpen en engineeringdocumentatie.
* Affiniteit met CAPEX\-projecten en industriële installaties.


**Wat maakt Vecon Engineers uniek?**



Of je nu net begint of al veel ervaring hebt, we kijken samen naar wat je nodig hebt om verder te groeien. We nemen de tijd om je te begrijpen en geven je de kans om je eigen stijl en richting in je werk te vinden. Zo kun je je vaardigheden verder ontwikkelen en de stappen zetten die voor jou belangrijk zijn.



Tenslotte hechten we grote waarde aan een fijne werksfeer. Dit zal je merken als je bij ons binnenloopt!

marc.deroos@veconengineers.com

jobs.title: Robotics Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Movu Robotics**  

Innovation, ambitious growth, technology, state\-of\-the\-art robots – that’s Movu Robotics in a nutshell. Due to the in\-house design and manufacturing process of our systems, an exciting, hands\-on work environment with plenty of challenges and advancement opportunities is guaranteed. Will you help shape the future of intralogistics?

 **Job Description**  

As a Robotics Validation Engineer you will:

* Define and develop Verification \& Validation procedures, work instructions, test scripts, and other documentation to demonstrate that the system is fit for its purpose and satisfies the stakeholders’ requirements.
* Review test procedures and develop new test benches if required.
* Document verification \& validation results.
* Recommend corrective actions and obtain stakeholder acceptance of validation results.
* Log defects and issues found during V\&V activities and track to closure.
* Prioritize project tasks to complete them on schedule while maintaining the quality of work.
* Collaborate closely and stay aligned with other groups, both within and external to stow Robotics
* Lead technical design reviews at various stages of the program lifecycle.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Master’s degree in Mechatronics, Electronics, Automation, Computer Science or related fields.
* 3\-5 years of engineering experience, preferably in manufacturing, automation, machine or aerospace industries.
* Hands\-on design and/or testing experience of electronic, mechatronics or electromechanical products, subsystems, or components.
* Knowledge of and experience with V\-cycle and testing procedures.
* Autonomous and a communicative team player.
* English is a must (C1 or higher).
* Eligible to work in Belgium.
* Mobile to Movu Robotics HQ in Lokeren daily (no telework).

  

**Additional Information** **What do we offer you?**

* A place in an enthusiastic, young organisation with the necessary ambitions
* The necessary freedom and opportunity to take initiative.
* An intensive training by experienced people.
* An attractive salary in an international environment with many benefits:
	+ Company car with fuel card/charging pass
	+ Group \& health insurance
	+ Meal vouchers (8€)
	+ Net allowances
	+ CAO90 Bonus
	+ Laptop
	+ iPhone \+ subscription
	+ 20 days of vacation plus 12 extra days for working a full year on 40h\-workweek instead of 38h (32 leave days in total)
* Satellite office in Berchem ( Antwerp )

*Unsolicited representations by third parties (recruitment agencies, headhunters, ...) of CVs via mail and/or telephone for our vacancies are considered as direct applications where no compensation is provided to the third party. Any T\&Cs from these third parties will not be accepted unless upon signature of the T\&Cs by a person in charge of HR. Candidates remain registered in the system for 12 months and cannot be proposed again during this period.*

The role acts as a strategic bridge between business and IT, translating business capabilities into actionable architecture roadmaps and technical blueprints while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, governance standards, regulatory obligations and operational requirements.


The architect will drive domain architecture governance, manage the application and platform portfolio, define long\-term roadmaps, support executive decision\-making through architectural trade\-off analyses, and ensure alignment across business, enterprise, solution, security, platform, data and information architecture disciplines. The position also requires expertise in AI architecture and governance, corporate business domains, integration architecture, SAP environments, and critical infrastructure contexts.


Your missions:


Domain Architecture \& Business Alignment


* Translate business capabilities into IT roadmaps in partnership with Business Architecture.
* Convert business processes into target architectures and implementation blueprints.
* Ensure alignment between business strategy, technology investments and enterprise objectives.
* Maintain a coherent and future\-proof IT landscape across the domain.

Architecture Governance \& Standards


* Define and enforce domain architecture principles, standards and reference architectures.
* Ensure compliance with local and group architecture guidelines.
* Present and defend architectural decisions before the Architectural Review Board (ARB).

jobs.title: Databricks Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Data Engineer**


Bouw jij graag end\-to\-end data pipelines en dataplatformen op Databricks?


Vertaal je complexe businessvragen moeiteloos naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen?


Ken jij Databricks van Auto Loader tot Unity Catalog en van Notebook tot Asset Bundle?


Dan ben **jij** de Databricks Data Engineer die we zoeken!

**Jouw impact**


Als Databricks Data Engineer bij EpicData zorg je ervoor dat data toegankelijk, schaalbaar en waardevol wordt. Je denkt én bouwt mee aan oplossingen die zowel technisch als functioneel kloppen, met het Databricks Data Intelligence Platform als fundament, meestal op Azure maar evengoed op AWS of GCP.


Je zet end\-to\-end lakehouse\-platformen op: van ingestie met Auto Loader en Lakeflow Connect, over batch\- en streamingtransformaties in PySpark en Spark SQL, tot een goed beheerde medallion\-architectuur in Delta Lake onder Unity Catalog. Daarnaast adviseer je klanten over hoe ze Databricks slim, veilig en kostenbewust inzetten, en neem je die rol op als teamspeler, inhoudelijk expert of technische lead, net wat de situatie vraagt.


Kortom: jij bent de schakel tussen data en business, en de lakehouse is jouw werkterrein.

**Wat ga je doen?**

**Data toegankelijk maken op Databricks**

* Robuuste batch\- en streamingpipelines bouwen met Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (voorheen Delta Live Tables), Auto Loader en Structured Streaming

jobs.title: Internship / Master Thesis: AI-powered Market Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
**Start date: February 2027 · Duration: 6 months**  

Please include your latest academic transcripts with your application. Applications submitted without transcripts will not be considered.


In this 6\-month internship or master thesis starting in February 2027, you will develop an AI\-powered internal platform that enables ELCA Business Lines to monitor market, technology and industry trends across selected sectors. The platform will consolidate information from external sources (industry reports, publications, market news, technology trends) and correlate it with internal knowledge assets such as project references, client information, competencies and business opportunities.


The goal is to provide actionable insights that help business leaders anticipate market evolution, identify emerging opportunities, strengthen go\-to\-market strategies and align investments in skills and offerings with future customer needs.


**Your tasks**

* Design an AI\-powered market intelligence platform that collects and analyses signals from external sources
* Identify and visualise emerging trends, opportunities and potential market disruptions
* Correlate external signals with ELCA's internal knowledge: projects, references, competencies and customer information
* Apply Generative AI and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques, and surface results through dashboards and recommendations
* Deliver a proof of concept and evaluate its business value for one or more ELCA Business Lines; as a stretch goal, propose gamification mechanisms to increase engagement

**What we offer**

* A dynamic, collaborative workplace with a highly motivated, multicultural team working across international sites
* The chance to make a difference in people's lives by building innovative solutions
* Access to state\-of\-the\-art AI tooling: the latest LLMs, AI coding assistants and an internal GenAI platform used on real client projects
* Internal coding events such as Hackathons and Brownbag sessions, plus our technical blog
* Monthly After\-Works organized at each location

**About your profile**

* Software development experience (Python, Java, .NET or similar)
* Understanding of AI, Machine Learning and Large Language Models
* Familiarity with data analysis, data visualization and information retrieval; knowledge of APIs, web scraping and data integration is a plus
* Interest in market analysis, technology watch and business intelligence, with the ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills
* Nice to have: Generative AI, RAG architectures, vector databases, knowledge management platforms, gamification

jobs.title: Senior Game Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Game Developer (Unity / C\#)**  
AI\-Future AG · Basel, Switzerland · Hybrid · Full\-time

**About us**

AI\-Future AG is a Basel\-based company developing a 3D game for mobile and tablet in the educational space. This is not a quiz app with a game skin: we are building a real game with a 3D world to explore, a third\-person character and genuine gameplay. We are a small team at an early, formative stage, building towards a fully playable game in the coming months.

**The role**

We are specifically looking for a game developer, someone whose background is in building games, not apps. You will own the game client in Unity, with your focus entirely on the frontend: gameplay, game feel and everything the player sees and touches. You will work directly with our Lead Game Designer and alongside other senior team members, turning design ideas into playable builds quickly and with high quality.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who is genuinely excellent at building games and wants to bring that craft into a product from an early stage.

**What you will do**

* Build and own the Unity client: gameplay systems, character control, camera, UI and game feel
* Structure the client codebase for long\-term maintainability: architecture, coding standards, code reviews
* Implement 3D gameplay features such as third\-person movement, procedural level generation from modular rooms and a modular character customization system
* Build editor tools that let designers and artists work without needing a developer
* Iterate closely with the Lead Game Designer on prototypes until the gameplay feels right

**What you bring**

* 5\+ years of professional game development with Unity and C\#, including shipped titles
* Outstanding gameplay programming skills and a strong sense for game feel and responsive controls
* Experience structuring a Unity project's architecture, not just extending existing code
* Solid understanding of mobile performance on iOS and Android
* Experience with 3D character controllers, cameras and animation systems
* Experience building Unity editor tools
* Clear communication and the confidence to raise technical concerns early
* Fluent English; German is a plus

**Nice to have**

* Experience with procedural generation
* Background in children's, casual or cozy games
* Experience in a technical lead role

**What we offer**

* Real influence on the game from an early stage
* Direct collaboration with an experienced senior team and short decision paths
* Hybrid role in Basel
* Salary: CHF 90,000 – 115,000 per year

**How to apply**

Send your CV and links to games or projects you have worked on. Tell us briefly which technical decision from a past project you are most proud of, and which one you would make differently today.

Pay: CHF90’000\.00 \- CHF115’000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Head Software Development Laboratory Weighing (f/m/d)**
=========================================================


**Location** Nänikon, Canton of Zurich, Switzerland **Date posted** October 01, 2026 **Job ID** 23259
**Our Opening and Your Responsibilities**
**For Software Leaders who want to shape technology, teams, and strategy**  

  

Laboratory Weighing (LabTec) is a global business area of METTLER TOLEDO. Our employees develop, manufacture, and market highly precise instruments that help customers maximize value in their demanding applications.  

  

At our global operational headquarters in **Nänikon\-Greifensee**, we are seeking a dynamic and motivated professional to lead our Software Team as **Head of Software Development Laboratory Weighing (f/m/d)**, 100%  

  

In this role you will lead a team of **approximately 30 software professionals** and become a **key member of the R\&D Leadership Team**. You will combine technical vision, people leadership, and business impact while driving the next generation of software solutions for laboratory weighing technologies. What you'll be doing in detail:
**Lead and Inspire High\-Performing Teams**
* Lead and develop a software organization of \~30 professionals.
* Manage and empower Team Leaders, Architects, and Software Engineers.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, growth, and engineering excellence.
* Guide critical software projects and organizational transformations.
**Drive Software Strategy and Architecture**
* Define and execute the software strategy across embedded, Linux, PC, and service software.
* Drive scalable architectures, platforms, and development processes.
* Increase software reuse, accelerate innovation, and reduce complexity.
* Support compliance and certification through smart software design.
**Shape the Future of Software Engineering**
* Own and evolve the Linux/Debian platform for future products.
* Advance development environments, CI/CD, test automation, and release processes.
* Strengthen engineering excellence through modern tools and practices.
**Lead Innovation in Emerging Technologies**
* Define and implement the AI strategy for software development.
* Establish best practices for AI\-enabled engineering tools.
* Drive cybersecurity initiatives and CRA compliance.
* Build capabilities for next\-generation software technologies.
**Collaborate Across Functions**
* Influence product roadmaps and strategic R\&D decisions.
* Partner with Product Management, Hardware Engineering, Service, and Quality.
* Manage external development partners and suppliers.
* Represent software topics at leadership level.
**What You Need to Succeed**
* **Education**: University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or comparable discipline. Solid technical foundation in software engineering and complex product development environments.
* **Software Development**: Extensive experience in software development for complex, hardware\-integrated products. Strong expertise in defining software architecture and platform strategies across multiple product lines. Proven experience developing software for proprietary hardware platforms and Linux\-based embedded systems.
* **Leadership**: Several years of leadership experience in software development, ideally leading leaders and cross\-functional teams. Collaborative leadership style with a passion for coaching, mentoring, and developing talent. Business\-oriented mindset with experience managing budgets, making data\-driven decisions, and driving organizational success.
* T**echnology \& Programming**: Strong hands\-on background in C/C\+\+, C\#, and Linux\-based embedded systems, preferably Debian. Deep understanding of modern software architectures, development processes, and platform\-based engineering approaches.
* **Language skills**: Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.
**Our Offer to You**
We offer:
* Flexible working hours (depending on the role), a hybrid work model, and a wide portfolio of training opportunities
* A 40\-hour work week with at least 25 vacation days per year, plus 4 to 7 additional days off between bank holidays
* Free parking and direct access to public transport
* Employees in Urdorf can purchase monthly lunch checks and enjoy healthy meals at a reduced price, either externally or in our cafeteria
* A range of additional attractive benefits, including employee discounts at select area businesses
You can expect challenging, interesting, and varied tasks in an innovative and international environment, with the opportunity to network globally and achieve your career goals.
  

  

Have we raised your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application at our Job portal.  

  

Please note that we do not accept any application documents via e\-mail, only applications submitted on our job platform due to our data protection guidelines. Furthermore, we do currently not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this role.
  

  

If you have any question, please do not hesitate to contact our Talent Acquisition Team ta\-ch@mt.com.
**About Mettler Toledo**
METTLER TOLEDO is a global leader in precision instruments and services. We are renowned for innovation and quality across laboratory, process analytics, industrial, product inspection, and retailing applications. Our sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry. Our products are sold in more than 140 countries, and we have a direct presence in approximately 40 countries. For more information, please visit www.mt.com.

jobs.title: Gaming DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced DevOps Engineer looking for your next career opportunity? The Gaming Area within Product Development is now hiring! The Gaming Area at Betsson Group focuses on Game Play and Game Discovery across all our brands and markets. We aim to offer the best gaming products in the industry and an exciting user experience when playing on our sites. We cover game lobbies, gaming initiatives, provider integrations and more.


**THE WOW**
-----------



Our Gaming platform is the core of everything we do. It supports all our gaming sites and is central to the company strategy.



You will be part of preparing our journey to containerization, improved delivery via cloud deployment, increasing the scalability of our systems while also maintaining their high quality. To accommodate new requirements, we are constantly re\-evaluating our systems design and working on exciting new features. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi\-brand platform to support 25\+ online brands! Our brands are used by hundreds of thousands of users and growing



To sum it up: you will be taking our Gaming platform, which is used by a worldwide audience, to a new level!


**A taster of what you will be involved with:**
-----------------------------------------------


* Working with cutting edge technology enabling our Cloud Journey
* The DevOps Engineer for our Gaming Department will be responsible for supporting development teams (both Backend and Frontent focused), and will be instrumental in enhancing CI/CD pipelines, improving monitoring and observability, and supporting \& mantaining other custom infra solutions.
* Take ownership of CI/CD pipelines, guiding developers to improve automation, reliability, and test coverage. Lead the migration from Octopus to GitHub Actions and foster a culture of developer\-led deployment
* Design and evolve monitoring systems with Prometheus/Grafana (or future alternatives), integrating observability into CI/CD workflows. Ensure robust tracing, logging, and metrics correlation across services.
* Support and extend custom\-built infrastructure components to handle increased traffic and complex routing. Collaborate with frontend and backend teams to ensure performance, scalability, and security.
* Work closely with all Gaming teams and DevOps engineers focused on infrastrucutre and operations. Provide tooling and guidance to developers across environments.

**What we're looking for:**
---------------------------


* Experience with GitHub Actions and Octopus; strong focus on deployment automation, speed, reliability, and test coverage. Ability to guide developers and foster ownership of CI/CD workflows.
* Proficiency with Prometheus/Grafana; capable of building dashboards, improving alerting, and integrating monitoring into CI/CD. Understanding of observability practices including tracing, logging, and metrics correlation.
* Experience with custom\-built NGINX setups; able to extend routing rules to support increased traffic and complex routing needs.
* Strong knowledge of AWS (EC2, ALB, VPC, EKS); experience managing infrastructure using Terraform and modules.
* Proven experience setting up and managing Kubernetes clusters, ideally with AWS EKS and Rancher RKE.
* Ability to write scripts in Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar for automation and tooling.
* Proficient in Git and versioned source control practices.
* Support build and deployment processes for both backend (.NET) and frontend (JavaScript/TypeScript, StencilJS) applications, ensuring smooth CI/CD integration and performance monitoring
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills; able to work with Gaming teams and Infra/Ops DevOps engineers.
* Solid understanding of DevOps culture and ITIL best practices. Problem\-solving mindset with ability to resolve complex technical issues efficiently.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions in a timely manner.
* Act as a technical enabler for development teams, providing tooling, guidance, and support across environments. Champion DevOps best practices and empower teams to take ownership of their delivery pipelines

**Who We Are**
--------------



Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960's. We're Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. Malaga is our newest tech hub where we are building one of the leading software engineering teams in Spain.



We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12\+ jurisdictions and 20\+ brands.



You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi\-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers!


**What we offer**
-----------------



Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with over 1,000 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint\-hearted, but if you're a go\-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you'll fit right in.

  


* 25 working days of paid vacation.
* Private health and life insurance.
* Flexible compensation package for transport, meals, and more!
* Hybrid work policy for the best of office and home.
* Up to 10 days per year working remotely from abroad.
* €300 yearly wellness allowance.
* Office perks to make your day easier.
* Referral program with a bonus for successful hires.
* Intensive summer schedule in August for extra flexibility and work\-life balance.


In addition to all of this, you will be part of the multi\-cultural Betsson community enjoying team\-building events, our Friday bars, our social clubs, parties and other events. There is always something fun to look forward to!

  


**Challenge accepted?**
-----------------------


**Check out the** **Betsson Group Blog** **to find out what our employees are talking about**


**If you are interested to learn more, please apply with your CV in English.**


***By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our*** ***Privacy Policy***
