jobs.description:
### **General information**


Job Title
Construction Safety Engineer
Ref \#
P1008824
Employment Type
Permanent
Department
Construction
Position level
Engineer
Date
Wednesday, September 23, 2026
AESC Office Location
Navalmoral de la Mata, Extremadura, Spain
### **Description \& Requirements**


Job Description
**Company Overview**
--------------------


AESC is a global leader in lithium‑ion and LFP battery technology, with a fast‑growing footprint across Japan, the UK, France, China, and the USA. It is now expanding in Spain with a €1‑billion gigafactory in Extremadura that will create up to 900 direct jobs in phase one. The Spanish facility is designed as the first net‑zero industrial park gigafactory in the country, in line with AESC’s mission to pioneer sustainable battery manufacturing.


**Role Purpose**
----------------


The **Construction Safety Engineer** will lead Health \& Safety management during the construction and installation of AESC’s battery gigafactory in Navalmoral de la Mata. The role sits within the Global Infrastructure \& Construction (GIC) team, reports to the Construction Manager and acts as the Owner’s H\&S representative on site. **The Engineer will make sure that contractors, suppliers and the Project Management Company (PMC) apply H\&S requirements in line with Spanish legislation, project standards and AESC’s requirements.** The work is **on site, focused on execution, coordination and control**. It involves close collaboration with the legally appointed Health \& Safety Coordinator (CSS), the PMC and Corporate EHS.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Project set\-up**


* Translate AESC Corporate EHS policies and standards into project\-specific H\&S requirements for construction and installation activities.
* Define H\&S requirements for contractors and suppliers, together with GIC and Corporate EHS.
* Align H\&S planning with the PMC and the legally appointed Health \& Safety Coordinator.
* Act as the Owner’s H\&S representative with the competent authorities when required.
**Construction \& installation**


* Lead on\-site H\&S supervision and coordination on behalf of GIC.
* Review contractors’ H\&S documentation (Construction H\&S Plans, RAMS, JSAs) and monitor how it is applied in the field.
* Monitor contractor compliance with applicable law, contractual requirements and the approved H\&S documentation, including the coordination of business activities (CAE) and subcontracting control.
* Coordinate daily with the Construction and Site Management teams so that H\&S is built into execution planning.
* Focus on the high\-risk activities typical of a battery plant build: heavy lifting, electrical works and energisation, hot works, work at height, confined spaces, and interfaces between contractors and equipment suppliers.
* Carry out site inspections, audits and safety walks, and escalate deviations through GIC project channels.
* Coordinate corrective actions with contractors, the PMC and the CSS, and follow them through to closure.
* Support incident investigations and make sure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Report H\&S performance, KPIs and critical risks to Project Management and Corporate EHS.
* Escalate critical risks and recommend stopping work through project governance channels when there is serious or imminent danger.
**Close\-out \& handover**


* Make sure that the construction H\&S documentation and deliverables required for handover are complete and compliant.
* Work with Corporate EHS to align with commissioning and operational H\&S requirements.
* Support final inspections, audits and regulatory reviews related to construction safety.
  

  

Led by a diverse and experienced management team, AESC employs more than 14,000 professionals worldwide. The company combines state\-of\-the\-art technology, Japanese craftsmanship and a strong track record in safety to deliver advanced battery solutions. AESC offers a comprehensive portfolio across various cathode chemistries and form factors, including LFP, NCM/MCA, and pouch, cylindrical and prismatic cell formats.


We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status.


Don’t you want to be part of this cutting\-edge and revolutionary company?


\#LI\-SD1


Requirements / Required skills
* Environment, Health, and Safety
* Health \& Safety
* Occupational Safety and Health Administration Training
* Contractor Safety
Qualifications
**Desired Requirements**
------------------------

  

  

* Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Building Engineering or a related technical field.
* Técnico Superior en Prevención de Riesgos Laborales covering the three specialities (Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Ergonomics \& Applied Psychosociology). Mandatory.
* At least 5 years of H\&S experience in large industrial construction projects, or at least 2 large industrial construction projects, with direct exposure to site execution, contractor management and multi\-interface environments.
* Proven experience coordinating H\&S on construction sites. The Coordinador de Seguridad y Salud qualification is highly valued.
* Proven experience supervising EPC/PMC contractors on multi\-contractor sites with complex interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience supervising high\-risk activities: lifting operations, electrical works, hot works, work at height and confined spaces.
* Solid knowledge of Spanish H\&S legislation, especially construction regulations (RD 1627/1997, RD 171/2004, Ley 32/2006\).
* Experience on the Owner/Client side, either directly or through a prevention service hired by the Owner, is a plus.
* Experience leading H\&S on at least one large project is a plus.
* Experience on industrial, chemical or energy projects is valued, especially gigafactories or lithium battery plants, as is having followed a project through to commissioning and handover.
* Experience working with international (e.g., Chinese) contractors and installers is a plus.
* NEBOSH or an equivalent international H\&S certification is a plus.
* Language Skills: Spanish – native or proficiency (mandatory); English – a plus.
* Based in Navalmoral de la Mata or within approximately 45 minutes by car, or willing to relocate. 100% on site.
* Strong leadership and authority on H\&S matters, including the ability to stop work when needed, with excellent coordination and stakeholder\-management skills, attention to detail, a proactive prevention mindset and the ability to perform under demanding project schedules.

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**Nombre de vacante** Cloud Operations Engineer
  

**Descripción** We’re looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Barcelona and help run reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient production platforms across a multi\-cloud, multi\-region, geo\-distributed environment. This is a hands\-on, operationally focused role supporting SaaS services and infrastructure that must remain highly available and performant around the clock.
  

  

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to support day\-to\-day operations, drive automation, strengthen observability, and reduce cloud waste through disciplined resource management. If you enjoy working across modern cloud platforms with real production responsibility and a bias toward operational excellence, this role is a strong fit.
  

  

This role includes participation in a 24/7 on\-call rota.
  

This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week in our Barcelona office.
  

  

First 90 Days
  

30 Days: Get to grips with Sage’s cloud estate: the AWS and Azure environments, Kubernetes workloads, observability tooling, and the operational processes that keep production running. Familiarise yourself with runbooks, incident procedures, and the teams you’ll partner with. Begin contributing to day\-to\-day operations and shadow the on\-call rota before joining it.
  

60 Days: Take active ownership of operational tasks across your assigned areas. Handle infrastructure maintenance, Kubernetes workload support, and incident response with growing confidence. Begin contributing to Terraform\-based infrastructure work and automation initiatives. Engage with Engineering and Security colleagues on ongoing improvements to observability and platform reliability.
  

90 Days: Operate independently across the full scope of the role: multi\-cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes operations, IaC, scripting, monitoring, and incident response. Contribute meaningfully to cost efficiency initiatives, documentation, and the team’s continuous improvement agenda. Be a reliable, collaborative presence in a fast\-paced global environment.
  

  

Meet the Team
  

You’ll join the Cloud Operations team – a hands\-on engineering group responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of Sage’s production SaaS platforms across AWS and Azure. The team operates across multiple regions and geographies, with a strong culture of automation, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.
  

  

You’ll work alongside Cloud Operations colleagues and partner closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams. The environment is fast\-paced and production\-focused – the kind of team that takes reliability seriously, values clear communication, and is always looking for ways to do things better.
  

  

How Success Will Be Measured
  

- Reliability and availability of the cloud infrastructure and services you support, measured against SLAs
  

- Speed and quality of incident response and service restoration
  

- Measurable reduction in cloud waste and improvement in cost efficiency across your areas
  

- Quality and coverage of operational documentation, runbooks, and support procedures
  

- Contribution to automation initiatives that reduce manual operational overhead
  

- Positive collaboration with Engineering, Security, and Product stakeholders

  

**Responsabilidades principales** Qualifications
  

  

Essential
  

- 3\+ years of experience in cloud operations, DevOps, SRE, systems engineering, or platform engineering
  

- Strong hands\-on experience with AWS or Azure, and working familiarity with the other platform
  

- Good understanding of cloud networking: VPCs/VNets, WAN, VPN tunnels and gateways, load balancers
  

- Kubernetes experience across deployment, operations, troubleshooting, and cluster support
  

- Experience with compute, storage, and platform services across cloud environments
  

- Infrastructure as Code experience, preferably with Terraform
  

- Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar
  

- Experience with observability and monitoring tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic Stack, Zabbix, ADX, or Fabric
  

- A practical approach to cloud cost efficiency: eliminating waste, right\-sizing resources, and promoting cost\-aware operations
  

- Linux administration and troubleshooting experience
  

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, comfortable in a fast\-paced global environment
  

  

Nice to Have
  

- Familiarity with Helm and Kubernetes release management
  

- Exposure to relational and non\-relational databases
  

- Relevant cloud certifications: AWS SysOps Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent
  

  

Want to know more about our Product?: https://hcm.sage.com/
  

  

At Sage, we offer you an environment where you can grow professionally without compromising your personal well\-being. Our benefits package is designed to provide stability, flexibility, and balance:
  

- Medical and dental insurance: Fully funded medical and dental insurance.
  

- Flexible benefits: Exchange part of your salary and make tax savings on meal and transport vouchers, childcare, and training.
  

- Well\-being: Free access to the Calm app (for up to 5 users), 24/7 counselling, and emotional support from our Healthy Mind Coaches. We also offer self\-care and parenting resources through the Cleo app.
  

- Flexible working: flexibility of working one hour in, one hour out, shortened workdays on Fridays and during the summer, and the opportunity to work from over 40 countries for up to 10 weeks per year through our Work Away program.
  

- Annual leave: 23 working days of vacation, 5 paid days per year for volunteering.
  

- Extended leave: 7 extra days of maternity leave and 5 extra days of paternity leave, on top of the legal allowance, available after one year of service.
  

- Financial support: Life and disability insurance, salary advances of up to 3\.5 times your net monthly pay, a €300 net marriage bonus, and access to Sage's employee stock purchase plan at a discounted rate.
  

- Learning and development: Free premium subscription to external learning platforms
  

  

Health and Safety Responsibilities
  

- Fostering the safety culture, by leading with your own example.
  

- Following established safety procedures and reporting potential hazards promptly helps maintain a secure and efficient workplace.
  

- Participating in safety training sessions and adhering to preventive guidelines and procedures, the objective is minimizing risks and protecting yourself and the rest of your colleagues.
  

  

This role is not open to visa sponsorship. Candidates must have a valid work authorization for the location listed and not require sponsorship now, or in the future, for their application to be considered.
  

  

\#LI\-AL2

A HARMAN Automotive\-nál nemcsak a technológiát fejlesztjük; a jövőt formáljuk. Globális, sokszínű csapatunk tagjaként lehetőséged nyílik arra, hogy kreativitásodat és szakértelmedet a világ vezető autóipari innovációiba ültesd át és ezáltal felgyorsítsd a karrieredet.


* Alkoss olyan prémium hangrendszereket és integrált technológiai megoldásokat, amelyek új szintre emelik a vezetési élményt.
* Használd találékonyságodat, kutatói alaposságodat és a csapat erejét a tervezési és mérnöki kiválóság jegyében, hogy mindig a legjobb megoldásokat hozzátok létre.
* Formáld a járműbe épített tájékoztatás, szórakoztatás, biztonság és élmény jövőjét.

**A pozícióról:**


Ebben a feladatkörben az elektronikai hibaanalízissel kapcsolatos folyamatok támogatásáért leszel felelős. Te biztosítod az új technológiák és berendezések bevezetését a gyártósori analízis osztályok számára.


Ez a lehetőség ideális lehet számodra, ha érdekel az elektronikai gyártás világa, szereted a gyakorlati problémamegoldást, és motivál, hogy hatásod legyen a gyártási minőségre és teljesítményre.


**Feladatok:**


* Elektronikai analízis módszerek fejlesztése, új metódusok kidolgozása
* Analízis specialisták és technikusok támogatása komplexebb hibaanalízisek során
* Analízis specialisták és technikusok oktatása új eszközökről, technikákról
* Gyártósori analízishez használt berendezések, mérőeszközök, módszerek fejlesztése
* Részvétel probléma megoldásokban, kapcsolat tartása a HW és SW mérnökséggel a műszaki problémamegoldás elősegítéséért
* Új projekteknél becsatlakozás az első minták gyártásától kezdődően, tudásbázis építése az új termékekről
* Új termékekről összegyűjtött információk rendszerezése, implementálás a széria gyártósori analízis folyamatokba
* Induló projekteknél analízis állomásokhoz szükséges berendezések meghatározása, összeállítása

**Szükséges:**


* Angol nyelvismeret
* Linux, Android és Windows rendszerek ismerete, magabiztos parancssori ismeretek
* Mérőműszerek felhasználói ismerete (oszcilloszkóp, spektrum analizátor, LCR mérő)
* Tapasztalat gyártósori analízis folyamatokban
* Automotive buszok ismerete (CAN, LIN, ethernet)

**Előnyt jelent:**


* programozási ismeretek (C\#, NI LabVIEW, Python)
* beágyazott rendszerek ismerete (SOC, uC)
* autókban használt RF rendszerek ismerete (FM, GPS, BT, Wi\-Fi, V2X)
* programozó és datalogger eszközök ismerete (UART, I2C, SPI, stb.)

**Ez vár rád** **nálunk****:**


* A rugalmasságot és a személyes kapcsolódást egyaránt fontosnak tartjuk. Hibrid működési modellünkben az irodai munkakörök többségében heti három napos irodai jelenléttel dolgozunk együtt.
* Élvezd a munkavállalói kedvezményeket világszínvonalú HARMAN és Samsung termékekre: JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG és még sok másra.

* Dolgozz a legmodernebb technológiákkal egy olyan környezetben, amely inspirál és támogat abban, hogy a legjobbat hozd ki magadból.

**Introduction: Career at HARMAN Automotive**


At HARMAN Automotive, we are shaping the future of connected vehicles by bringing innovative technologies from development into high\-volume manufacturing. As part of the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering Test organization, you will help implement and industrialize automotive electronics products such as Infotainment Systems, Audio Amplifiers, Telematics Control Units (TCUs), and other connected vehicle platforms.


* **Develop and implement** manufacturing test solutions that enable the successful launch of complex automotive electronics products.
* **Partner with global teams** across engineering, quality, suppliers, and manufacturing to deliver robust and efficient production processes.
* **Advance manufacturing excellence** through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of test technologies and methodologies.
* **Support the future of mobility** by ensuring the quality and reliability of connected, intelligent, and customer\-focused automotive systems.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


As a Regional AME Test Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the test strategy and manufacturing test infrastructure for next\-generation automotive products. Working as an individual contributor, you will partner with cross\-functional teams across engineering, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, and global technology organizations to develop reliable, efficient, and standardized test solutions. Your work will directly impact product quality, production efficiency, and the successful launch of new technologies into manufacturing. This position is a strong fit for engineers who enjoy technical ownership, continuous improvement, and delivering innovative test solutions in a global environment.


**How You’ll Make An Impact**


* Develop manufacturing test concepts, specifications, and validation strategies that ensure product quality and support successful product launches.
* Lead the development and implementation of hardware and software solutions for test equipment, enabling reliable and efficient testing throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with product development, quality, manufacturing, and supplier teams to deliver robust test systems that meet customer, regulatory, and production requirements.
* Optimize test processes, cycle times, and test coverage to improve manufacturing efficiency, reduce quality risks, and lower operational costs.
* Drive continuous improvement by introducing new test technologies, measurement methods, and industry best practices into manufacturing operations.
* Coordinate test equipment deployment from concept through commissioning, ensuring systems are ready for prototype builds, industrialization, and serial production.
* Contribute to global engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned activities to strengthen test engineering capabilities across HARMAN locations.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* Strong understanding of manufacturing test engineering principles, including test concepts, validation methodologies, and production test systems.
* Ability to design, develop, and troubleshoot test equipment hardware and software in a manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of C\# programming for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of manufacturing test applications and automation solutions.
* Solid understanding of electronics fundamentals, including analog and digital circuits, measurement techniques, signal analysis, and hardware troubleshooting.

* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.

* A continuous improvement mindset focused on innovation, standardization, and operational excellence.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem\-solving, and quality is expected.

* Experience with automotive electronics manufacturing and end\-of\-line test systems.
* Familiarity with industrial test platforms, automated measurement equipment, or fixture development.
* Knowledge of statistical methods such as MSA, capability analysis, or process performance evaluation.
* Experience working with international suppliers and global engineering teams.
* Understanding of automotive quality standards and processes, including IATF 16949 requirements.

**Things To Know**


* This role is based in Székesfehérvár, Hungary and supports global automotive manufacturing and engineering activities.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support suppliers, manufacturing sites, and engineering teams.
* Professional working proficiency in English is required to collaborate effectively with global engineering and business partners.

**Senior Construction Manager (Civil)**

  


**The project:**

  


Provides civil engineering leadership across the programme, aligning design, construction and technical assurance to deliver integrated infrastructure outcomes. The role focuses on substructure works, stormwater, drainage, flood mitigation and hydraulic coordination, connecting technical excellence with wider network integration and programme success.

  



**You’ll be responsible for:**


**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:**


* You will promote Mace's value of Safety First, exhibiting visible safety behaviours, sharing lessons learned and using safety moments and Mace's HSW framework to support the safety and wellbeing of all Mace staff.
* You will possess technical expertise in local health and safety rules and regulations relevant to project portfolio.
* You will promote a diverse and inclusive working environment and understand the importance of the wellbeing of the people in your team.

  

**Client focus – Deliver on our promise:**


* You will ensure robust quality systems are in place and suitably managed in line with service excellence.
* You will manage delivery from project inception/brief, through design development and planning, contractor procurement and construction phase in accordance with the overall delivery program and agreed project milestones.
* You will manage tasks and associated deliverables in support of the Associate Director and other senior leaders, alongside the wider project and client teams, to ensure the timely and accurate delivery of the project.

  

**Integrity – Always do the right thing:**


* You will manage project budgets and highlight any risks, challenges and mitigations.
* You will support the long term development of your function or Business Unit (BU), creating a sustainable business future.
* You will commit to making a positive impact for our people, our clients, and our planet, and take ownership for holding others to account who do not uphold the Mace values.

  



**Create opportunity for our people to excel:**


* You will manage design and wider consultant teams in a collaborative manner to ensure effective completion of responsibilities.
* You will lead and manage the project team and relevant stakeholders to achieve strategic project key performance indicators (KPIs).
* You will actively network, innovate, and seek understanding of best practice, utilising the full depth of knowledge of Mace Group, the Centres of Excellence, Mace Way Control Centre and Knowledge Hub.

  


**Your responsibilities:**


* Provide technical leadership for civil engineering disciplines across multiple delivery packages.
* Review engineering designs for compliance with programme requirements and applicable standards.
* Lead technical reviews associated with substructures, earthworks, roads, utilities, structures and drainage systems.
* Provide specialist technical guidance on stormwater design and flood management systems.
* Coordinate technical interfaces between civil and utility disciplines.
* Review temporary and permanent works proposals.
* Support the resolution of technical design and construction issues.
* Manage technical risk identification and mitigation activities.
* Monitor technical performance and compliance during delivery.
* Works within the project MEP team leading the construction of the MEP services and ensuring of compliance with Mace standards.
* Accountable for the construction aspects of the MEP services and management of the site environment, programme, Health Safety \& Wellbeing, Quality \& Commissioning of the project.
* Liaises and coordinates with key project stakeholders, forming strong working relationships with the Client, Consultants, Trade Contractors and other team leaders.
* Manages the checking and overseeing of design output to ensure information is clear, achievable, buildable, conforms to preferred methods and is available to enable efficient procurement and construction of works.
* Prepares and implements delivery strategies and programmes for all phases of the project, ensuring the key milestones, interfaces, dependencies, logistics and work sequencing are all properly considered.
* Develops and implements project specific dimensional control strategy ensuring adherence and delivery of project and strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Establishes company \& project quality requirements and procedures are implemented and adhered, ensuring quality standards are met.
* Manages and contributes to the production of quality assurance information, ensuring standards are embedded across teams and projects.
* Manages \& provides leadership to team/s and/or project team of Managers and Professionals, ensuring the standards, structures, tools, capabilities and responsibilities are in place to deliver team/project plans and deliver excellence.
* Manages technical aspects of project including innovations and technical developments and identifies and implements continuous improvement plans/identifies key business improvements.
* Provides performance management, technical development and coaching to team and/or project team.
* Manages \& influences Key/Senior stakeholders, building key internal/external working relationships. Works collaboratively towards the common goal of net zero carbon transition and share responsibility for the proactive identification and management of the associated carbon emissions and reductions during the delivery of work.
* Degree qualified in Civil or Structural Engineering. (or equivalent), Professionally qualified with the Institution of Civil Engineers, Institution of Structural Engineers or similar professional body.

**You’ll need to have:**


* :Degree in Civil Engineering.
* Extensive experience in major infrastructure programmes.
* Strong knowledge of civil infrastructure delivery and substructure works.
* Thorough experience in stormwater design, drainage systems and hydraulic infrastructure.
* Experience undertaking technical assurance and engineering reviews.
* Chartered Engineer status is preferred.
* Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Commercial and delivery awareness within complex, multidisciplinary programmes.
* Ability to work effectively in a remote site environment and manage competing priorities.
* Commitment to health, safety, quality, sustainability and collaborative working.

  

**Our values**

  



**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well\-being in every team.

  



**Client focus \- Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long\-term relationships with our clients.

  



**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

  



**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

  


Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.

  



We are also open to discussing part\-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

new_jobs.title: Automation & GenAI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Rotterdam \+ Den Haag·Fulltime


  
Je hebt AI\-prototypes gebouwd. Nu wil je het moeilijkere werk doen: zorgen dat ze betrouwbaar genoeg zijn voor de echte operatie.


Bij WARP werk je in kleine senior teams aan digitale producten met gevolgen buiten je laptop. Je eerste uitdaging ligt binnen een complex, datarijk programma waar tempo, zorgvuldigheid en goed beoordelingsvermogen tegelijk tellen. Je bouwt en verbetert oplossingen rond LLM's, koppelt ze via REST API's aan bestaande systemen en zorgt dat wat je oplevert ook echt in productie werkt.


Je pakt backendwerk, pipelines en integraties op, ziet waar processen slimmer kunnen en vertaalt dat naar praktische stappen. Minstens zo belangrijk: je kunt uitleggen wat de techniek doet, waarom een keuze is gemaakt en waar de grenzen liggen — zonder je achter jargon te verschuilen.


Dit is hands\-on engineering in een omgeving met veel stakeholders en weinig ruimte voor theater. We hebben plek voor twee mensen.


**Over jou**
------------


* Minstens één jaar hands\-on ervaring in een vergelijkbare AI\- of automatiseringsrol
* Sterke programmeervaardigheden en praktische ervaring met LLM's, backendontwikkeling en REST\-integraties
* Comfortabel in complexe, datarijke omgevingen
* Een afgeronde WO\-master
* Uitstekend Nederlands, mondeling én schriftelijk — dit is een harde eis
* In staat om technische keuzes helder uit te leggen aan niet\-technische stakeholders
* Gevoelig voor context: je begrijpt dat timing, afstemming en vertrouwen soms net zo belangrijk zijn als het technisch perfecte antwoord
* Ervaring met LangChain, LlamaIndex, Python, PyTorch, Keras, Azure OpenAI of Document Intelligence is een plus
* Een verbetermentaliteit: nieuwsgierig, pragmatisch en nooit uitgeleerd
**Perks**
---------


* Een plek bij WARP met vanaf dag één een inhoudelijk stevige uitdaging
* Senior collega's, veel vertrouwen en echte ownership
* Werk waarin AI verder komt dan slides en demo's
* Hybride werken, met Rotterdam als thuisbasis en Den Haag voor deze uitdaging
* Ruimte om de diepte in te gaan, breder te groeien of een onverwachte afslag te nemen
**Wat kan je**
--------------


* GenAI
* LLMs
* Python
* REST
* APIs
* Azure
* Automation
**Over ons**
------------


We zijn een Rotterdams team van ervaren engineers, designers en strategen. We bouwen digitale producten en strategieën voor organisaties waar het werk ertoe doet: havens, ziekenhuizen, supply chains en energienetwerken. Soms brengen we het team, soms sluiten we aan waar onze expertise het verschil maakt. Hoe dan ook blijven we dicht op het echte werk. Kleine teams, hoge inzet, eerlijke gesprekken. Bewijs jij liever dingen dan dat je ze presenteert? Dan pas je hier.

Sie arbeiten an Anspruchsvollen Aufgaben im KRITIS\-Umfeld mit hohen Anforderungen an Stabilität, Sicherheit und Verfügbarkeit. Des Weiteren arbeiten Sie mit einem modernen On\-Premise\-Technologie\-Stack.

  

IHRE AUFGABEN:

* Eigenverantwortliche Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der OpenShift\-Plattform

IHR PROFIL:

**UNSERE BENEFITS**

new_jobs.title: Graduate Naval Architect Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Location
London, United Kingdom
Category
Engineering
Date Published
30/09/26
Status
Open
**About the job:**


Kent is looking for a Graduate Naval Architect Engineer to be based in London.


Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?


Our Naval Architecture teams across the UK operate globally in both the Offshore Wind and Oil \& Gas markets working towards reducing carbon emissions. As a graduate in one of our locations, you will be contributing to a variety of technically challenging and exciting projects, from designing new offshore wind farms, substations and floating concept designs, to supporting our clients through the range of consultancy services we offer, including feasibility studies, concept and sizing, and life extensions.


**About our Graduate Scheme**


Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.


If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future\-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.


Our global graduate program offers hands\-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.


**Application Process**


As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.


**Application Deadline**


All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.


**Recruitment Timeline**


Shortlisting and pre\-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026\.


**Eligibility**


Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.


**Hybrid Working**


We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.


**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**


**Skills \& Responsibilities:**


You’ll be joining a team spread across various UK locations that actively encourage and foster innovative solutions and new approaches to our client’s problems. It should be highlighted that the majority of the Naval Architecture team are based in our London office and this would be our preferred location for graduate development. You will be joining a RINA accredited Graduate Scheme to help you towards chartership. Your work could involve the following:


* Design and analysis of floating and fixed offshore structures. This could be fixed and floating offshore wind turbines, semi\-submersibles, FPSO/FLNG vessels across the life of the asset, from concept study through to decommissioning.
* Analysis of vessels and offshore structures using techniques including: hydrodynamic analysis, mooring analysis, stability analysis, transportation analysis and structural assessments.
* Learning to use tools such as: DNV SESAM (inc. (inc. GeniE, HydroD, SIMA \& Riflex), Orcina Orcaflex, and Python.
* Interfacing directly with clients, representing our teams to discuss engineering solutions to complex problems.
* Supporting our external markets, business development and work winning activities.
In addition to the responsibilities listed herein, the employee may be required to perform other ad\-hoc tasks as needed or directed by the supervisor or management. These tasks will be within the reasonable scope of the employee's skills, capabilities, and role within the organization. The intent of this provision is to allow for flexibility and adaptability in meeting the dynamic needs of the organization, ensuring that operational requirements can be met efficiently. All such tasks will be assigned considering the employee's current workload and with respect to their professional development.


**Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:**


* Master’s/MEng degree in Naval Architecture, Maritime Engineering or Ship Science.
**Communication:**


* Excellent command of the English language in both oral and written communication and skills.
**Behaviour/ Core Competencies:**


* A passion for working in a consultancy environment.
* Embracing equality, diversity and inclusion in everything you do.
* A desire to work collaboratively with a curious approach, challenging yourself to find new solutions.
* Enthusiasm and drive to develop your skillset and seek out development opportunities within a supportive team.
* Motivation to achieve professional accreditation (where applicable), making the most of the support given within Kent for gaining chartership.
* Comfortable to embrace agile ways of working and learning new technologies.
* We are looking for candidates who are due to graduate in 2027, or have graduated in the last 2 years.
**HSSEQ:**


The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the Company; it’s clients and the governing authorities of the host country.


We are committed to our diverse and inclusive community \- a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop. From day one, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and employee networks to support staff from different backgrounds.


As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.


We’re a disability\-friendly employer and can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. Please contact us confidentially at recruitment.uk@kentplc.com to find out how we can support you.
